accessMethod: full official primary university pages opened with web research tool
newFindings: Beihang's School of Mathematical Sciences currently lists the Department of Statistics and Operations Research as one of four actual departments. This is a title-qualifying unit distinct from the existing School of Economics and Management Management Science department.

The same school page says the school has doctoral programmes in Mathematics and Statistics and lists Operations Research and Optimization as one of six Mathematics research directions. It does not explicitly identify which school department formally hosts Mathematics doctorate candidates or designate that research direction as a named degree specialization. No second doctoral route is added from this page.

sources.note: Full official School of Mathematical Sciences page, lines 111–120: four actual departments, Mathematics/Statistics doctoral provision, six Mathematics research directions including Operations Research and Optimization.
Full current central doctoral overview says over 30 programmes across eight disciplines; not an exact departmental host map.

limitations: A qualifying actual department is verified, but do not presume every Mathematics/Statistics doctoral student belongs to it. Exact doctorate-to-department host mapping or formal named concentration is needed before an additional route.
Other Beihang technical school inventories remain incomplete. Existing verified Management Science and Engineering route is retained separately.
